review.subject: Pet food bag with floating chicken, carrot, beet ingredients
review.summary: A pet-food pouch sits in the middle of a magenta gradient while ingredients (turmeric, chicken, carrot, rice, spinach, beet) drop in around it and then exit, followed by a typewriter headline and tagline and a logo end card. Reads as a 2D composite of cut-outs with one very slow push-in; shot data splits it into only two shots, so the sheet is the better guide.

beats.note: Logo at top, bag settles with slight tilt, magenta gradient.
Ingredients pop in around bag in sequence, then fade out.
Bag straightens, headline and tagline typed on.
Bag clears, logo and tagline scale up on magenta.

shot_labels.note: Product bag at centre, ingredients float in over magenta
Bag, headline and tagline reveal, slow push-in

learn: Hold the product centred over 17s of slow easeIn push; let ingredients carry the motion.
Stagger ingredient entrances ~0.5s apart, each dropping from above with a small arc.
Clear all ingredients before the claim so the pack is readable at the payoff.
Type the headline on a clean second line then reveal the tagline, held about 4s.
End on a logo-only card with a gentle scale-in.
